svg.text: Waveshare ESP32-S3-RS485-CAN — Reed Switch Pin Mapping
Internal pull-ups enabled — no external resistors needed
Active LOW — magnet present (door closed) pulls input LOW
Reed switch other terminal connects to GND
IO43 doubles as TXD — used for RSW12
IO19/IO20 reserved for USB — do not use
Picket — RSW_PINS[] in main/main.c (12 reed switch inputs)
